HOME Cakna is the Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) initiative of HOME, established in 2018. We are dedicated to creating meaningful change by empowering communities through structured, impactful programs that focus on education, well-being, and sustainability.

stories.title: Beyond the Classroom: HOME Tanjung Minyak's Community Impact
stories.excerpt:
At HOME Tanjung Minyak, education is just one part of the bigger picture. This center is making waves with their heartfelt initiatives that not only care for the planet but also for the people around them.

♻️ 1. Recycle to Donate
What if recycling could change lives? HOME Tanjung Minyak proved it could. Through a “Recycle to Donate” campaign, recyclable items were collected and converted into donations for Palestine via Persatuan Cinta Gaza Malaysia. This simple act brought students and the community together, raising awareness about sustainability and global humanitarian needs.

🤝 2. Lending a Hand to Local Business
When a nearby minimart (Jojok Mart) faced a power outage, HOME Tanjung Minyak didn’t hesitate to help. They generously shared their electricity supply so the shop could continue supplying burger ingredients to local hawkers. It was a small gesture with big impact—supporting livelihoods and strengthening ties within the community.

stories.title: Creating a Kinder, Greener HOME at Klebang Besar
stories.excerpt:
At HOME Klebang Besar, everyday actions reflect a deeper commitment to both the environment and people. The team implements smart waste separation practices and promotes energy and water conservation through visual reminders at key points in the centre.
Their impact goes beyond environmental awareness. From strengthening tutor-parent relationships through feedback surveys to ensuring structured management systems that keep teaching and learning on track. Every detail, from monthly meetings to learning progress reports, shows that Klebang is serious about quality, care, and sustainability.

stories.title: Everyday Sustainability at HOME Semenyih Ecohill
stories.excerpt:
At HOME Semenyih Ecohill, going green is more than just a trend, it’s a way of life. The center actively embraces eco-friendly practices such as using LED lighting, tapping into solar energy, and reducing plastic usage in their daily operations. These small but consistent efforts are part of a bigger mission to create a sustainable and responsible learning environment.
But their commitment doesn’t stop with the environment. HOME Semenyih Ecohill also prioritizes human connection — strengthening bonds through regular parent engagement sessions, fostering open communication within the team, and maintaining a work culture that is both structured and supportive.

This thoughtful balance of environmental care and community wellbeing reflects the center’s dedication to long-term impact — nurturing not just young minds, but a better future for all.

stories.title: A Small Act of Care at HOME Shah Alam Seksyen 9A
stories.excerpt:
At HOME Shah Alam Seksyen 9, a simple gesture is making a meaningful difference.

The team has introduced a thoughtful routine—providing light snacks for MTs (Math Tutors) during their teaching sessions. While it may seem small, this act of care goes a long way in helping tutors stay focused, feel appreciated, and enjoy a more comfortable teaching environment.

It’s proof that support doesn’t always have to be big. Sometimes, it just needs to be thoughtful.

stories.title: Sustainable Steps at HOME Klang Bandar Puteri
stories.excerpt:
At HOME Klang Bandar Puteri, sustainability isn’t just a goal—it’s a daily habit.

The center takes simple but impactful actions to reduce waste and conserve energy. By replacing paper with reusable whiteboard sheets and installing solar-powered lights at key areas, the team is actively creating an eco-friendly learning space.

These small, thoughtful choices don’t just benefit the environment—they also teach students the value of being responsible and resourceful every day.

stories.title: HOME Bandar Perda Champions 3R: Small Steps Towards a Greener Future
stories.excerpt:
At HOME Bandar Perda, sustainability isn’t a campaign—it’s a classroom culture. Through consistent, hands-on practices, the center integrates the 3R concept: Reduce, Reuse, Recycle into everyday learning.

From minimizing single-use plastics to creatively reusing teaching materials and setting up clearly labeled recycling bins, every step taken by the center helps shape eco-conscious habits among students. These aren’t just green routines—they’re life lessons.

By making sustainability part of the school day, HOME Bandar Perda is not only creating a cleaner space but also nurturing a generation that’s more mindful of the environment.
